name: CutCraft v0.0 (Release Update)
releaseNotes:
CutCraft v0.0 Release:
- Video Preview Playback Engine with seamless timeline scrubbing and frame stepping
- Interactive Play/Pause transport controls with Space, K, J, L shortcuts
- Real-time Subtitle & Caption overlay preview
- Built-in Auto-Updater engine (Version 0.0) with update checks & install
- Accessibility screen reader live announcements and audio cues
